messages:
alex: Quick check — planning a gated rollout for NimbusCorp. We want to enable the per-customer flag `llm_adaptive_batching` for their account only. Contract asks for a 5% canary then ramp to full for their reserved capacity. Want ops + eng-platform eyeballs on gating rules + VIP handling before I flip the switch.

maria: Can you paste the exact flag key and intended audience? also need the CR/PR link so oncall can trace.

jordan: Flag key will be `feature:llm_adaptive_batching:v1`. Plan: create a customer-scoped toggle with explicit allowlist + a percentage rollout fallback. Example config we used last time: 
```json
{
  "flag_key": "feature:llm_adaptive_batching:v1",
  "audience": {
    "type": "customer_allowlist",
    "customers": ["nimbus-12345"]
  },
  "rollout": {
    "canary": {"type": "percentage","value": 5},
    "on_success": {"type": "customer_scope","value": "all_reserved"}
  },
  "guardrails": {
    "latency_p99_ms": 200,
    "error_rate_pct": 0.5
  }
}
```
This will let us enable for Nimbus specifically, run a 5% traffic canary, then if metrics good, expand to their reserved pool.

samira: Two quick notes: 1) For enterprise customers with contract gating, prefer using explicit customer allowlist entries + a contract metadata check (`contract_version >= 2024-04-01`) rather than relying only on percentage. 2) VIP handling: some Nimbus users are marked as `vip=true` in tenant metadata — we should exclude VIP traffic from the canary unless legal signs off (they expect zero risk).

ops-bot: deploy-checklist: infra quota ok, autoscaler limits verified, canary route exists (:white_check_mark:). CI: green.

elaine: legal confirmed contract gating requirement. They want an audit trail event when the flag flips for Nimbus (who flipped it, timestamp, contract id). Can we add that to the rollout action?

alex: Good call. I'll add an audit hook to the rollout action and ensure the flag flip event contains `contract_id` + `actor`. Plan: enable customer allowlist immediately but keep canary traffic at 0% until we validate perf on a staging mirror. After 1 hour of mirror verification, move canary to 5% for 30m, watch p99 and errors, then 100% on reserved pool.

maria: Sounds safe. Please add the PR/CR here so I can attach to the oncall incident page. Also add the rollback command snippet (ops likes one-liners).

jordan: PR: https://git.internal.redwood/infra/flags/pulls/487
Rollback one-liner for ops: `curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOGGLER_TOKEN" \n  https://toggles.redwood/api/v1/flags/feature:llm_adaptive_batching:v1/revert -d '{"target":"nimbus-12345"}'`

samira: Guardrail thresholds we will watch: p99 <= 200ms, error_rate <= 0.5%, token-cost delta <= +15% vs baseline. If any breach, auto-revert and page oncall.

elaine: Also add a manual opt-out for Nimbus VIPs: `customer_metadata.vip = true` => flag disabled. Ops needs that in the flag rules.

alex: Will do. Timeline: mirror testing starting in 30m, canary after successful mirror for 1h, then ramp if green. I'll post updates here. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: monitor: created dashboard `rollout/nimbus/llm_adaptive_batching`, alert `nimbus.flag.regression` configured.

maria: Acked, will post CR on the oncall page and ping SRE if alerts fire.

jordan: I'll land the PR after mirror verification and add the audit hook.

samira: Thanks — leaving a short checklist here for post-rollout:
- verify audit entries for flag flip
- confirm VIP exclusion applied
- confirm metric baselines recorded
- confirm billing delta acceptable

alex: Thanks all. Will update thread with results.

elaine: :eyes: keep me posted on any VIP friction.

maria: thx!
